name: Compare Judgments Export Plan
description: Add a compare-judgments export flow that mirrors project export, uses one canonical rowFilter model, and keeps compare-page rows and exported CSV rows aligned in prompt and summary modes.

userStories.title: Define the canonical compare rowFilter contract
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want compare judgments to use one shared `rowFilter` enum so page state, export state, and server filtering all use the same mutually exclusive contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a shared `rowFilter` type with `multiple-answers`, `fully-answered`, and `all` values.
Update comparison page and export request contracts to use `rowFilter` instead of separate row-filter booleans.
Missing or invalid `rowFilter` values normalize to `multiple-answers`.
Targeted `bun test` for comparison route/export coverage passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.
`bun run desktop:build` passes.

userStories.title: Normalize legacy compare filter URLs to rowFilter
userStories.description: As a user, I want old compare-page filter URLs to normalize into the new canonical `rowFilter` search param so bookmarked links still land in a sensible state.
acceptanceCriteria: Legacy `showOnlyFullyAnsweredPrompts=1` normalizes to `rowFilter=fully-answered`.
Legacy `showAllRows=1` normalizes to `rowFilter=all` when the fully answered legacy param is not present.
Legacy URLs are replaced with canonical `rowFilter` and `differenceFilter` params after parsing.
When both legacy checkbox params are effectively active, the page normalizes to the stricter `rowFilter=fully-answered` state.
Targeted `bun test` for comparison route/export coverage passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.
`bun run desktop:build` passes.
Verify in browser that legacy compare URLs normalize to the canonical `rowFilter` state.

userStories.title: Update the comparison judgments endpoint to use rowFilter
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the comparison judgments endpoint to accept the new `rowFilter` enum so server filtering remains the single source of truth for prompt-mode and summary-mode row inclusion.
acceptanceCriteria: `POST /api/comparison-projects/:id/judgments` accepts `rowFilter` together with `differenceFilter`.
`rowFilter=multiple-answers` keeps the current default sparse-row behavior for both prompt mode and summary mode.
`rowFilter=fully-answered` requires all shown columns to be answered for the returned row.
`rowFilter=all` bypasses the row answer coverage filter while preserving difference filtering.
Targeted `bun test` for comparison route/export coverage passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.
`bun run desktop:build` passes.

userStories.title: Replace compare-page checkbox filters with the rowFilter select
userStories.description: As a user, I want one row-filter select on the compare judgments page so the filter choices are clear and mutually exclusive.
acceptanceCriteria: The compare judgments page replaces the two row-state checkboxes with a single select bound to `rowFilter`.
The select shows `All rows`, `Rows where all shown columns are answered`, and a mode-aware sparse-answer option label.
The compare page removes its extra client-side row filtering and renders the server-filtered rows and counts directly.
Changing the select updates the canonical URL state and refreshes the judgments query.
Targeted `bun test` for comparison route/export coverage passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.
`bun run desktop:build` passes.
Verify in browser that compare-page row counts stay aligned with the server-filtered rows after the client-side post-filter is removed.

userStories.title: Expose article summary in comparison row data
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want comparison row data to include article summaries so the compare export can include the same article context users expect from project exports.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend `ComparisonProjectJudgmentsRow` to include `articleSummary`.
Comparison row queries select `article_summary` together with title and article-created timestamp.
The compare page remains visually unchanged while the extra row field becomes available for export.
Targeted `bun test` for comparison route/export coverage passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.
`bun run desktop:build` passes.

userStories.title: Share comparison column ordering between page and export
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one reusable comparison-column ordering helper so the compare table and CSV export always use the same column order.
acceptanceCriteria: Extract the current compare-page column-order logic into a shared utility.
The compare page uses the shared ordering helper without changing visible column order.
The helper remains usable by the export page and CSV generation code.
Targeted `bun test` for comparison route/export coverage passes.

userStories.title: Extract batch-friendly comparison row assembly helpers
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want shared batch-friendly comparison row helpers so paged results and streamed exports can reuse the same row assembly and filter logic without materializing the whole dataset in memory.
acceptanceCriteria: Extract reusable helpers for stable scoped-article selection, batch cell assembly, and pure row-filter evaluation.
The judgments endpoint reuses the shared helpers while preserving current row semantics.
The shared row shape includes `id`, `articleTitle`, `articleSummary`, `articleCreatedAt`, and `cells`.
The helpers support streamed export batching instead of requiring one full filtered row array in memory.
Targeted `bun test` for comparison route/export coverage passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.
`bun run desktop:build` passes.

userStories.title: Add the compare judgments CSV export endpoint
userStories.description: As a user, I want a compare-judgments CSV export endpoint so I can download all rows that match the same filters used on the compare page.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `POST /api/comparison-projects/:id/export` that accepts `rowFilter` and `differenceFilter`.
The endpoint streams CSV rows incrementally over stable article batches instead of building the full file in memory first.
The CSV includes `Title`, `Abstract/Summary`, and `Date added` before the ordered comparison answer columns.
CSV header ordering matches the compare results table ordering.
Newline-delimited multi-answer cell values are flattened to `; ` in the CSV output.
Archived comparison projects remain exportable through this read-only endpoint.
Targeted `bun test` for comparison route/export coverage passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.
`bun run desktop:build` passes.

userStories.title: Add compare export client wiring and entry points
userStories.description: As a user, I want clear compare export entry points and a dedicated export page so I can export prompt-mode or summary-mode comparisons from the grid or the comparison details screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Add compare export entry points in the comparison grid and the comparison detail page.
Archived comparison cards also show `Export data` while `Edit` remains active-only.
Add `/compare-judgments/$id/export` with comparison metadata, filter controls, and an `Export to CSV` action.
The export page carries active compare-page search params into the export flow so users start from the same filter state.
Extract or reuse a shared client CSV download helper so project export and compare export use the same download behavior.
Targeted `bun test` for comparison route/export coverage passes.
`bun run lint` passes.
`bun run build` passes.
`bun run desktop:build` passes.
Verify in browser that prompt-mode and summary-mode comparisons can be exported from the compare export page.
Verify in browser that archived comparison projects expose the export flow in read-only form.
Verify in browser that the compare export page opens with the active compare filters already applied.
Verify desktop export-page load and download behavior if the shared route or download wiring changes affect desktop packaging.
